newsitem.title: PERU: Peru Congress may lower banks' risk asset ratio.
newsitem.headline: Peru Congress may lower banks' risk asset ratio.

text.p: The Peruvian Congress' Economy Committee has recommended lowering the maximum ratio of risk- weighted assets to net worth for the country's commercial banks, the government daily El Peruano reported Wednesday.

In a full-chamber debate scheduled for Thursday, Congress is expected to follow the committee's proposal of giving banks until 2000 to reduce their risk assets to a value only 11 times the banks' net worth, down from a current 12.5 times net worth, El Peruano said.

The Central Reserve Bank had called for Congress to lower the ratio still further to 10 times net worth, but the government-controlled committee has chosen to follow the recommendation of Economy Minister Jorge Camet.
Both the government and central bank recommended lowering the ratio to help insulate the banking system from any external shock the economy might suffer.
